design: The design of the training sample with its own seed: one random position per stratum (mode, musWM Roman numeral with inversion, agreement pattern) and a simple random sample of the other shared-key positions. No position the training sample has held. Left out before drawing, from the score alone: positions whose key name and key signature are spelled on opposite sides. Order shuffled.
